Prehistoric India.question: Which of the following is the most important characteristic feature of the Neolithic Age?
Prehistoric India.explanation: The Neolithic Age is mainly identified by the beginning of agriculture and food production. This transformed human life from food gathering to settled life.
Prehistoric India.elimination_logic: Eliminate option c because iron tools belong to Iron Age. Eliminate option d because coinage came much later in historical periods. Polished stone tools are important but agriculture is the defining feature.
